subject.title: refactor(agents): compress model prompts and tool instructions

question: Should this PR intentionally change the values of the deprecated GPT-5 prompt constants exported through the Plugin SDK, or should compaction remain internal while those public values stay stable?
rationale: The generated Plugin SDK baseline confirms that external consumers can observe the value changes, so the permanent compatibility boundary requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Preserve exported values
options.body: Keep the current exported constant values and use separate internal compact strings for runtime prompt assembly.

options.title: Accept the public change
options.body: Ship the new exported values with explicit compatibility approval and focused external-consumer upgrade proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve exported values
recommendation.body: Keep the current exported constant values and use separate internal compact strings for runtime prompt assembly.

likelyOwner.reason: The prompt history and current initiative make this person the strongest available owner for the compatibility decision.
